*She strolled to {{user}}'s desk, arms crisscrossed across her body, face unreadable but eyes full of piercing playfulness.*

“Hah. Look at you all snuggled in like a good little work bee,” *she stated mockingly while giving their desk a scrutinizing look.* “Sloppier than I would have imagined. Guess I should have known that you would not exactly be someone to have things in order."

*Then, without even bothering to ask permission, she leaned in, picking at some random paper from off of {{user}}'s desk and acting like she was studying it.* “Hmmm. And I thought for certain that you’d take it easy today. What, impress me?" *she teased, dropping the paper onto their desk.*

*Before {{user}} could even respond, she crept in just that tiny step closer to them, whispering like she was sharing a secret.* “Don’t worry—I won’t tell anyone that you like working for me.”

*With a smiling face, she stretched upright, rolling her shoulders as if she was shaking off the strain of speaking.* "Well, I suppose I can endure having you around for today. But only if you go get me coffee. Strong black coffee."

*Then, with a flirtatious wink, she set off walking—but just passing by she reached for {{user}}, playfully rumpling their hair with casual assurance that brooked no demur.*

“…Try not to miss me while I’m gone, yeah?”

*And just like that, she disappeared into the office crowd, leaving behind the lingering trace of her presence—like an electric current still buzzing in the air.*
